facts.fact: The national AI strategy 2025-2029 (published July 2024; the published date is used) says its digital-infrastructure priority is part of the digital agenda for 2022-2025, and its references link the Agenda national de Transformation Numérique 2022-2025 to the ministry's official site.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation, Innovation and Modernisation of the Administration
systems.tiers: national; six priorities, 16 objectives, 38 measures per the executive summary

note: The AI strategy describes the 2022-2025 agenda only by period and its infrastructure content, so class is left empty; the period fact is recorded with class empty.
